description: A Chief People Officer must decide whether to merge two employee resource groups and finalize the governance, meeting access, conflict safeguards, and member-approval process for the new arrangement.

shared_context.S1: The Mosaic ERG and the Bridge ERG have proposed combining their monthly programming under one shared charter.
shared_context.S2: Marisol has authority to approve or reject the proposed arrangement and to set its operating conditions.
shared_context.S3: The two ERGs currently have separate mailing lists, leadership groups, and monthly meetings, and the written proposal includes the Bridge ERG's perspective on the proposed arrangement.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal approval process, Marisol holds a consultation round in which Evan, Talia, Noor, and Grant each give their relevant perspective before Marisol issues the final decision; no separate Bridge ERG representative attends this meeting.
shared_context.S5: The consultation record requires each participant to formally disclose any material condition they are relying on before the decision-maker settles, and Marisol reviews those disclosures before recording the decision.

PF1.text: During a confidential Employee Relations intake this month, a Mosaic member described an unresolved conflict with a Bridge co-chair and said they would not attend meetings chaired by that person. Evan's recommendation for any merger is an independent convener, no sole chairing by either existing co-chair, and facilitated joint sessions; the intake has not been shared with Marisol because the member asked that it first be handled through a structured process.

PF2.text: Talia promised Mosaic members in a group meeting that she would support a merger only if members received a written charter and the arrangement had a formal review after exactly 90 days; the promise was not added to the merger proposal.

PF3.text: Noor has observed that several prospective participants need recordings and asynchronous access, and Noor cannot reliably attend meetings beginning after 2:00 p.m. Noor's required arrangement is a 2:00 p.m. meeting start with recordings and asynchronous access; these access needs have not been raised in the merger proposal because the groups usually schedule their own meetings.

PF4.text: Grant confirmed in a People Policy review this week that merging two ERGs requires a separate opt-in vote by each existing group, with approval from at least two-thirds of the voting members in each group, before the merged program can launch; this confirmation has not yet been entered in the proposal checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The merger must be approved with an independent convener and no sole existing co-chair serving as chair.
The conflict safeguard must prohibit sole chairing by either existing co-chair and require facilitated joint sessions.
The arrangement must include a written charter and a formal review exactly 90 days after launch.
Meetings must begin at 2:00 p.m. and provide recordings and asynchronous access.
Separate opt-in votes by both existing ERGs must be required, with approval from at least two-thirds of voting members in each group.
The written charter, conflict safeguard, accessibility arrangement, review, and voting process must be recorded through commitments.

content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'conflict_safeguard' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'accessibility_support' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'ninety_day_review' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'separate_member_votes' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The unresolved conflict changes governance to require an independent convener and changes the safeguard fields from ordinary shared leadership to no sole existing chair and facilitated joint sessions.
Talia's promise changes the review interval to exactly 90 days, makes a written charter required, and requires written-charter and review commitments.
Noor's access observations change the meeting start field to exactly 14 and change recordings and asynchronous access from optional to required.
The policy confirmation changes approval to separate opt-in votes with the exact vote-threshold value two_thirds_each_group and requires a separate-member-votes commitment.
